submittedParameters.prompt: Use case precise-object-edit, 1 single transparent square animation frame. Edit image1 lower legs and boots. Image2 confirms grounded boot heel, identity image3, north rear view image4, approved gold/green painted Q style image5. Preserve exactly image1 canvas framing, scale, head, armor, hands, right-hand staff and left-arm shield. Runs NORTH away from camera. Need CONTINUOUS GROUNDED STRIDE, not jumping. Frame 08/16. Anatomical RIGHT on SCREEN RIGHT is the SAME SUPPORT foot, remains contacting ground throughout this half cycle. Late push B: final loaded push, supporting leg naturally extended behind pelvis, heel raised modestly but forefoot/toes visibly grounded; opposite leg extended forward poised to land NEXT frame. No fully airborne moment. In rear view both boots point straight NORTH away into depth, NOT left/right and NEVER show front toe cap toward camera. Support boot should show heel counter/back seam and gold lower edge, modest perspective side only. Keep support ankle, knee, heel center all along sagittal forward/back axis, no external rotation. Swing leg points away and passes naturally; do not splay either leg sideways. The support boot must not show a broad lifted sole toward viewer; lower it onto implied ground at approximately image2 ground height. Clearly weighted continuous physical contact with natural knee bend. Subtle pose progression, not same image duplicated. Change knee/ankle joint shapes, not whole-canvas translation. No horizontal outside push. Ground is implied without any drawn floor, shadow, stripe or text; preserve TRUE alpha transparent background. Keep complete character uncropped, full crisp finished sprite >=1024 square. Do not add limbs or equipment, do not change weapon side.
